name: wickedsick
description: Wicked Sick plugins for the agents we actually use

plugins.name: token-usage
plugins.description: A token profiler, not a cost meter: attributes Claude Code and Cowork usage to the slash command, skill or subagent that consumed it.

plugins.name: wizzo-fleet-presence
plugins.description: Fleet presence for Claude Code: four hooks (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SessionEnd) call acsendr's coordctl with --vendor claude-code, so every session on a box appears on the Agent Mesh and in Jarvis. Supersedes per-repo .claude/settings.json wiring. Fail-open; no secrets — the hub bearer stays in ~/.config/wizzo-coordination/.env as an op:// reference.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Prefer existing code, the standard library and native platform features; keep the smallest correct implementation without dropping validation, security or accessibility.

plugins.name: solar
plugins.description: Live Solar System data from Solar (sol.wickedsick.com): what's up tonight, lessons by UK key stage, space fact-checks, object explainers, asteroid close-approach watch, weekly sky content and catalogue audits — via the free public Solar MCP
